data.revised_prompt: High-quality 3D chibi educational app avatar, a single fictional Chinese schoolgirl aged about 8 to 14, suitable as a student profile icon for a campus teacher portal. Square 1:1 composition, tightly focused on the head; front-facing or slight three-quarter view. The face and hair together fill 75% to 85% of the canvas, with only a tiny bit of neck and shoulders visible at the bottom; absolutely not a half-body portrait. Full hair silhouette visible within frame, no head cut-off, no hair cut-off, no chin cut-off. Distinct features readable at 48 px: one thick side braid gathered behind the shoulder, side-swept bangs, and a small yellow daisy hair clip at the braid start. Gentle, friendly closed-mouth smile. Bright brown eyes. Soft studio lighting, refined modeling, soft materials, clearly a student, not an adult, not a teacher. Only one character. Bottom edge shows just a small amount of white school collared shirt, no emblem, no text. Background must fully cover the entire square canvas edge-to-edge, from all sides to all corners, with a solid low-saturation coral orange color; no white borders, no transparency, no circular frame, no ring, no halo, no scene. Clean, bold silhouette, minimal detail, high contrast, readable at small sizes. No props, no hands, no gestures, no headset, no headphones, no suit, no makeup, no jewelry, no top cropping, no hair cropping, no shoulder-dominant composition, no white background, no logo, no watermark, no multiple characters, no realistic photo, no flat 2D illustration, no dark tone, no low resolution, no malformed facial features.
